name: Nauru
summary: Nauru's Succession, Probate and Administration Act 1976 covers estates, but Nauruan custom matters and there is no statutory family provision. Trust and foundation law and Hague status are not confirmed.
family_claims: No statutory family provision (2003 Supreme Court noted Nauru had not adopted such statutes; courts have used equitable and customary principles). Not re-verified for later years.
foreign_law_note: No conflict-of-law rule sourced. The 1976 Act applies to a Nauruan only if the person left a will in English-Wills-Act form that so directs (s 3(2), per a case summary).
trust_note: Nauru is understood to follow received English trust law; no Nauruan trust statute was found, so 'limited' is recorded. No foundation law found.
open_questions: Whether Nauru has any trust or foundation statute.
Direct reading of the 1976 Act s 3.
